payload.campaign: uuid — the campaign whose live session's player view opens the window
payload.media: uuid — an illustration of that campaign, shown in the floating window at its default position and width, the three set together (window-fields-together); its height is width × height_px / width_px, never stored (window-proportional). A media that is no illustration of the campaign is rejected under window-proportional; the base is not touched. A session whose diffusion is not committed yet (nothing sent to the player view, or a first send still pending or in review) is refused: a window makes no row
